entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker bound by demonic pacts and the Chain Veil, who is attacked in her manor by Jace's mind and then called to a tower by her master.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who assaults Liliana's mind with accusations about the Drownyard, then leaves for Thraben to confront Avacyn.

entities.name: The Raven Man
entities.description: A white-haired, golden-eyed spectral figure in black and gold robes who has taunted and taught Liliana since her youth; only she (and, briefly, Jace's image) can see him.

entities.name: Gared
entities.description: A hunched servant with mismatched eyes who watches Liliana's manor and summons her to the tower on his master's orders.

entities.name: Dierk
entities.description: The man of learning whom Gared serves, who waits in the tower and needs the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Innistrad's archangel, who has turned on her own flock with violence.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker Jace had sought.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Liliana lives and where Thraben is its greatest city.

entities.name: Liliana's Manor
entities.description: Liliana's storm-lashed manor with a high tower, guarded by zombies.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The greatest city on Innistrad, which Liliana besieged and took; home of the cathedral where Jace hopes to find Avacyn.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: The ruined manor where Jace found a moonfolk journal.

entities.name: The Drownyard
entities.description: A stone structure off the Nephalian coast where zombies build and angels wheel, which Jace thinks Liliana is behind.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The coastal region of Innistrad where Jace saw the Drownyard.

entities.name: Ovitzia
entities.description: A place from Jace's childhood memories where he kept a dog.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A silken-linked artifact that amplifies Liliana's necromancy, with which she killed two demons and took Thraben; it whispers to her, hurts to wear or discard, and is called the Object by her master.

entities.name: Zombies
entities.description: Liliana's undead servants, including tattered sentries.

entities.name: Orzhova
entities.description: The wealthy Ravnican guild whose gold Liliana says would not tempt her to help an angel.

events.summary: Liliana broods in her manor during a storm, recalling how she made demonic pacts and used the Chain Veil to kill demons and take Thraben.
events.quote: had besieged and taken Thraben itself, the greatest city on Innistrad

events.summary: Liliana can no longer bear to wear the Chain Veil, but cannot get rid of it without unbearable pain.
events.quote: But when she tried to get rid of it, the pain was unbearable.

events.summary: The Raven Man appears beside Liliana as a second voice speaks into her mind.
events.quote: He had appeared to her in her youth, taunted her, taught her.

events.summary: Liliana realizes the intruding voice is Jace, who is invading her mind.
events.quote: Are you insane? I almost killed you!

events.summary: Jace binds Liliana's zombies with ropes of light so they cannot reach him.
events.quote: ropes of light bound their arms and legs, sent them toppling to the ground.

events.summary: Liliana's death magic passes through a Jace illusion, which pops.
events.quote: The bolt of purple light slid right through him, and his image popped like a soap bubble.

events.summary: Jace accuses Liliana of helping the angels at the Drownyard.
events.quote: And you're helping them. Admit it!

events.summary: Liliana realizes Jace can see the Raven Man, and strikes the real Jace with a bolt of magic.
events.quote: She let loose a bolt of magic at Jace, the real Jace, that left him doubled over in pain.

events.summary: The Chain Veil amplifies her magic and backlash racks Liliana as Jace presses his mental assault.
events.quote: The backlash started, agony suffusing Liliana as the Chain Veil took its toll.

events.summary: Liliana tells Jace she does not want to hurt him; the pounding stops and the Raven Man vanishes in disgust.
events.quote: The Raven Man sighed in disgust and disappeared in a rustle of feathers.

events.summary: Jace, disoriented, tells Liliana about Markov Manor, the moonfolk journal and the stones pointing to a drownyard in Nephalia.
Jace theorizes that Liliana is redirecting mana to the Drownyard to be rid of the Chain Veil.
events.quote: These stone things are redirecting all this mana, and it's all going to this drownyard henge

events.summary: Liliana insists she had nothing to do with it, and Jace slumps in relief.
Jace announces he must go to Thraben to find Avacyn; Liliana warns Avacyn will kill him.
events.quote: I have to go to Thraben,

events.summary: Liliana charges her hand with necromancy, and Jace grabs her wrist and aims it at his chest, daring her to kill him.
events.quote: and pointed her glowing palm at his chest.

events.summary: Liliana tells Jace through a story of a pet that she would be sad when he dies but would get over it.
events.quote: Because that's how I'll feel when you're dead, you idiot,

events.summary: Jace leaves for Thraben, expecting to die there.
Gared tells Liliana that his master bids her come to the tower with the Object.
events.quote: The Master bids you come to the tower,

events.summary: Liliana follows Gared up the tower stairs with the Chain Veil, while a raven watches and vanishes.

relations.note: He taunted and taught her and set her on her path.
relations.quote: He had appeared to her in her youth, taunted her, taught her.

relations.note: Gared refers to him as Master and relays his summons.
relations.quote: Master Dierk is a man of learning,

relations.note: He addresses her as Mistress and watches her house.
She betrayed him after befriending him, though she grew fond of him; their relationship is described as dysfunctional.
relations.quote: betraying him had torn out one more strand of her threadbare sense of humanity.

relations.note: She keeps it hidden in a pocket; it whispers to her and she cannot discard it.
relations.quote: It whispered to her, even now, from the hidden pocket where she kept it.

relations.note: She besieged and took the city to get at a demon.
relations.quote: had besieged and taken Thraben itself, the greatest city on Innistrad

relations.note: Avacyn has turned on her own flock.
relations.quote: Avacyn had turned on her own, had unleashed violence and cruelty that seemed to shock everyone besides Liliana.
